about.text: A firm, salty white cheese from the Spanish-speaking Caribbean and Central America, made to be sliced and fried rather than melted. In the Dominican Republic and Nicaragua it is the cheese used for queso frito, slices of fried cheese.

how.text: Queso para freír is a firm, salty fresh white pressed cheese from the Dominican Republic and Puerto Rico that softens but keeps its shape when fried, turning crisp and golden outside and soft inside.
